nodes.label: Tooling Preflight
nodes.rationale: Before planning or implementation, show evidence from graphify, at least one code-index call, and context7 or package-registry when external library behavior matters.

nodes.label: Post-Implementation Quality Gate
nodes.rationale: After Python edits, run ruff, mypy, and make napoleon-gate, and fix reported problems before finishing.

nodes.label: Prefer Third-Party Packages
nodes.rationale: Prefer maintained open-source packages over building the capability, judged by commit cadence and stars, using context7 and package-registry to evaluate them.

nodes.label: No Runtime Workarounds For Doc Gates
nodes.rationale: Put the correct product change in the real source file; do not add monkey-patches or startup hooks to dodge napoleon or baseline noise.

nodes.label: regis_inspector Package Layout
nodes.rationale: Models belong in regis_inspector.models, services in regis_inspector.services, and CLI interaction only in regis_inspector.cli.

nodes.label: Thin Facade And Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: One job per service class, methods at most 60 lines, public service as a thin facade, and per-run mutable state isolated in an orchestrator.

nodes.label: ExtractionOrchestrator
nodes.rationale: Cited as the reference for per-run orchestration plus a RunStats accumulator driving stateless collaborators such as DdlExtractor, at regis_inspector/services/orchestrator.py.

nodes.label: Napoleon Documentation Contract
nodes.rationale: Non-test Python needs class contracts, only applicable docstring sections, and Napoleon #: comments, enforced by make napoleon-gate against a baseline.

nodes.label: botocraft Before boto3
nodes.rationale: Prefer botocraft models and managers; if support is missing, stop and ask whether to extend botocraft or use boto3.
